Sample.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/5] Participants were interviewed in one of three settings: an acute psychiatric ward for older adults (9), a medical ward for older adults (2) or their own homes (4).

Type.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/5] Participants were initially approached about the study by a mental health professional known to them. Once it was established that they were willing to be interviewed, they were contacted to arrange an interview time and location. Interviews took place between five days and 20 weeks after the suicide attempt (most within four weeks).
